card.name: Time spans just before a duration phrase
card.fires_on: Words in news and astronomy text that come right before a time reference such as 'until the end of', 'since the beginning of', or 'about this time'. It fires on linking words like 'since' and 'about', or on a noun like 'object' before a time phrase.

modes.label: Date and horizon words
modes.description: Scattered words such as a comma in a date, or 'western' before 'horizon'.

card.writes: It favors short-to-medium time spans such as months, weeks and seasons, and disfavors long spans such as decades.
card.plain: It marks a spot where the text is about to say how many months or weeks something lasts, not decades.
